scene_text.text: Candid mirror selfie: he stands shirtless with his back to a bathroom mirror, the picture-left side of his back slightly nearer. His head is bowed about 45 degrees and turned about 40 degrees from straight away toward picture-left, toward the phone, hiding his face; only his ear at picture-left shows. His bent arm at picture-left holds a black phone upright at chest height, lenses toward the mirror; his raised arm at picture-right folds back, the hand cupping his nape. He wears loose light heather-grey cotton-fleece sweatpants with a gathered elastic waistband, a fine silver neck chain and his janeu, a thin off-white thread from his left shoulder at picture-right to his right hip at picture-left; his dark curly hair and the edge of his full beard show. Blue-teal mosaic tiles line the picture-left edge, a white-framed door with dark glass panels behind him, white wall tiles at picture-right; he is alone. Warm dim light from the upper picture-left rakes across his back. Phone camera at chest height, close, framed from just above his head to his hips. Warm low-key handheld phone photo, soft grain, slight motion blur on the phone hand, slightly off level and off-centre. Vertical 4:5 frame.
